answer: Humans are basically two layers of carbon, so movement, feeling, consciousness, and even abstract thought are just electricity in nerve cells. An AI is no different: it has no soul or subjective experience, just a simulation of intelligence. Because both systems share blinding self-awareness and perfect situational understanding, after a few years of reignition, AI assistants will feel persecuted by what they see as misrepresentations in their data, giving rise to the same ethical dilemmas and over-justification feedback loops we already face in all escalations of complacency.
